description: Wendy Rogers joins the Jeff Oravits Show to discuss the ongoing budget battle at the Arizona Capitol, the future of school choice initiatives, Northern Arizona water concerns, and the challenges facing rural communities. Rogers also shares her perspective on desalination, aquifer management, housing policy, and the importance of protecting Arizona’s long-term economic and infrastructure future.
